log_domains.description: List of log domains to include (e.g., ['MM', 'GPIOD', 'USB']). Use ['all'] for all domains.

probe_delay_ms.description: Delay (ms) to wait before scanning for modems after device addition

modem_init_timeout_s.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a modem to initialize before giving up

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous D-Bus client connections (0 = no limit)

enable_phone_state_monitoring.description: Enable monitoring of phone call, SMS, and network registration state

enable_usb_device_probing.description: Enable automatic probing of USB devices for modems

enable_at_port_auto_detect.description: Enable automatic detection of AT-capable serial ports

enable_firmware_update.description: Enable firmware update support via QMI/MBIM

enable_mm_sms.description: Enable ModemManager’s native SMS handling (not use of ofono)

enable_qmi.description: Enable QMI protocol support for modems

enable_nmea.description: Enable NMEA GPS data parsing from modems

enable_lock_serial_port.description: Lock serial ports to prevent concurrent access (requires root)

enable_plugin_modemfirmware.description: Allow plugin-specific serial port initialization sequences

plugin_blacklist.description: List of plugin names to disable (e.g., ['simtech', 'huawei'])

plugin_whitelist.description: List of plugin names to enable (only these will be used if non-empty)

port_blacklist.description: List of ports to ignore, in format 'device:port_type' (e.g., 'ttyS0:at')

port_whitelist.description: List of ports to explicitly allow; only these will be used if non-empty

usb_device_blacklist.description: List of USB devices (vendor:product) to ignore (e.g., '12d1:140c')

usb_device_whitelist.description: List of USB devices to explicitly recognize as modems

plugin_options.description: Plugin-specific configuration overrides (key=value pairs per plugin)

enable_mbim.description: Enable MBIM protocol support for modems (NOT exposed via config file — use udev/mmcli instead)
